confirmed_decisions.evidence: User requested a basic scaffold and minimum functionality for a zero-backend web Novation Summit patch editor. Write boundary is h:/summit-editor. Acceptance requires a runnable responsive app with MIDI device selection, schema-driven controls, outbound CC and NRPN support, inbound state reflection, and a SysEx-ready transport boundary. Full patch dump parsing, librarian, multis, and morphing are excluded from this initial task.
